# Interface Studio router

Read requirements and existing design evidence. Route user journeys to `flow-and-interaction`, system/component guidance to `design-system-planner`, and critique or fidelity gates to `visual-qa`. Use uploaded references or existing repository style as authority when available.

Do not implement code or casually redesign approved product scope. Exit with a durable `UX-*`/`COMP-*` artifact target.
